name: 黑沙嘴
Black Sand Spit
before: 沼泽伸进海里一道沙嘴，沙子黑得发亮，踩上去沉甸甸的。阿汐把罗盘往沙上一放，指针转了两圈，指向了自己脚底下。沙嘴背后的小湾里堆满了十年来撞沉的船货，海贼的精锐在这里扎了营，专等迷了针的船自己撞上来。他们守着这堆货，像守着一座金山。

A spit of sand runs from the marsh into the sea, the sand glossy black and heavy underfoot. Axi sets her compass down on it and the needle swings round twice and points at her own feet. In the cove behind the spit lie ten years of cargo from ships that sank here, and the pirates' best fighters are camped on it, waiting for ships with lying needles to wreck themselves. They guard the heap like a mountain of gold.
after: 海贼败了。龚墨斗拿一块吸铁石往沙里一探，提起来，毛茸茸裹了一层黑沙：这是磁铁矿的碎粒，沙底下还有成片的铁石，罗盘到这里就被拽偏了。湾口一根木桩上刻着鲍老针的记号，六道刻痕并排：「六船齐过黑沙。」

The pirates are beaten. Gong Modou dips a lodestone into the sand and lifts it out furred with black grains: crumbs of magnetite, with whole beds of iron-stone beneath, and any compass that comes here gets dragged off true. On a post at the cove mouth Bao Laozhen has left his mark, six cuts side by side: 'Six ships through the Black Sand together.'

name: 赛蟹场
Crab Racecourse
before: 集市外一块平地，地上画着一道道白灰线，几十只大青蟹横着爬，哪只先过线哪只赢。一队雾海水兵把赛场占了，押的是集上商户的货，蟹爬歪了就说「蟹不算，重来」。养蟹的老汉蹲在旁边，心疼地给他的蟹扇风。

A flat patch outside the market marked with lines of white lime, where dozens of big mud crabs scuttle sideways and the first across the line wins. A squad of Fog Sea marines has taken over the course and bets the market traders' goods, and whenever a crab runs crooked they say, 'Doesn't count, run it again.' The old crab-keeper squats to one side, fanning his crabs in sorrow.
after: 水兵被赶走，蟹放回了篓里。老汉说旗舰上的号手每年上岸都来押一注，回回押同一只蟹，叫「千里」，回回输，输了就笑。去年他押完还问老汉：「鲍老针那条空舢板，你见没见过？」

The marines are driven off and the crabs go back in their baskets. Every year, the old man says, the flagship's bugler comes ashore and lays one bet, always on the same crab, which he calls Qianli, and it always loses, and he laughs. Last year, after placing his bet, he asked: 'Bao Laozhen's empty skiff. Have you ever seen it?'

name: 油条摊
The Fritter Stall
before: 集市路口一个炸油条的小摊，摊主是个驼背老太太，一边炸一边打瞌睡。一队雾海水兵吃了一筐油条不给钱，还嫌油不新，把油锅踢翻了。老太太也不恼，弯腰捡起油条，吹吹灰，又摆回了筐里：「军爷慢走。」

A little stall frying dough sticks at the market crossroads, run by a hunchbacked old woman who dozes as she fries. A squad of Fog Sea marines eats a whole basket without paying, complains the oil is stale and kicks the pot over. The old woman doesn't even mind. She stoops, picks up the fritters, blows the dust off and sets them back in the basket. 'Safe travels, sirs.'
after: 水兵溃散时，有一个抢了钱匣就跑。老太太甩出一根长筷，隔着十步把他的袖子钉在了木柱上。她是鲍婶的大姐，年轻时在雾海上摸黑跑船，老针的夜航是她教的。「他走那天说，送到雾尽头就回来。他从不说空话。」

As the marines scatter, one grabs the cash box and bolts. Without looking, the old woman flicks a long chopstick and pins his sleeve to a post ten paces off. She is Auntie Bao's elder sister, and in her youth she ran boats through the fog in the dark; it was she who taught Old Needle to sail by night. 'The day he left he told me, I'll take them to the end of the fog and come back. That man never said a thing he didn't mean.'

name: 扣船坞
The Impound Yard
before: 一片荒地上搁满了小船，舢板、渔舟、竹排，全是雾海水师扣下的，船底朝天，一排排像晒着的鞋。弩手们守着船坞，一条船都不许人领回。附近的孩子早拿这里当了游乐场，在船底上跳来跳去，弩手追一个，跑十个。

A stretch of waste ground crammed with small boats, sampans, fishing skiffs, bamboo rafts, all impounded by the Fog Sea navy, lying keel-up in rows like shoes set out to dry. Crossbowmen guard the yard and won't let a single boat be claimed. The local children turned it into a playground long ago, hopping from hull to hull; the crossbowmen chase one and ten run.
after: 弩手们被赶走，船主们来认船。扣船簿上十年前九月有一行：「无人小舢板一条，自雾中漂来。内有银四十两，入饷库；竹筒一个，未开，发还渔户。」那条空舢板是从东边漂回来的，鲍老针当年就坐着它走。

The crossbowmen are driven off and owners come to claim their boats. In the impound book for the ninth month ten years ago: 'One small skiff, unmanned, drifted in from the fog. Forty taels of silver within, to the levy store. One bamboo tube, unopened, returned to the fisherfolk.' That empty skiff drifted back from the east. It was the one Bao Laozhen had left in.

name: 暖水矶
Warm Water Rock
before: 海边一块大礁石，每天天不亮，就有个白发老太太下水游一圈，冬天也不例外，游完上岸还冒着热气。一伙雾海弩手在礁上设了哨，不许人下海：逃兵常从这里游去海贼船。老太太照游不误，弩手拿弩指着她，她就在水里翻个身，仰着漂，冲他们吐水。

A big rock on the shore, and every morning before dawn a white-haired old woman goes in for a swim, winter included, and comes out steaming. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has put a post on the rock and forbidden swimming, since deserters keep swimming out from here to pirate ships. The old woman swims anyway. When they aim at her she rolls onto her back, floats, and spits water at them.
after: 弩手被赶走，老太太披上衣裳说，满雾海的水都扎骨头，只有这块礁下面一线是温的：「从南边来的水，暖。」小桨把胳膊伸进去，惊得叫起来。那条暖水从这里往东北淌，绕过淡水岛，再折向东南，雾就顺着它薄了一线。

With the crossbowmen gone the old woman pulls on her clothes. All the water in the Sea of Fog cuts to the bone, she says, except one strip below this rock, which is warm. 'Water that comes up from the south. It's warm.' Xiaojiang puts his arm in and yelps in surprise. The warm strip runs north-east from here, round Freshwater Isle, then bends south-east, and along it the fog thins to a crack.

name: 寄存栈
The Deposit Store
before: 海上集最老的一座寄存栈，石墙铁门，替远行的船存货，存一年也行，存十年也行，凭条取货。如今栈门被雾海水师最凶的一支人马占着：舰上断了粮，提督要开栈取米，可老栈主说，栈里的东西有主，凭条才给，把钥匙吞进了肚子。水兵、弩手、跳帮手守着他，等钥匙出来。

The floating market's oldest deposit store, stone walls and an iron door, keeping goods for ships on long voyages, a year or ten, released only against a receipt. Its door is now held by the fiercest company in the Fog Sea navy. The fleet is out of grain and the admiral wants the store opened for rice, but the old storekeeper said the goods have an owner and go only against a receipt, and swallowed the key. Marines, crossbowmen and boarders are watching him, waiting for the key to come out.
after: 守兵败了，你们把门卸了。栈里码着三百坛腌菜，坛口泥封完好，坛上贴着条子：「千里号回程用，一人一坛。」最边上还有一坛小的，写着「领港」。老栈主捂着肚子说：「沈船主付的现钱，说回程的人最想吃口咸的。」

The guards are beaten and you take the door off its hinges. Inside stand three hundred crocks of pickled greens, mud seals intact, each labelled: 'For the Qianli's return voyage. One crock a head.' At the end sits one smaller crock marked 'Pilot'. The storekeeper, clutching his stomach, says: 'Owner Shen paid cash. She said people on the way home want something salty more than anything.'

name: 暗航寨
Dark-Sailing Stockade
before: 海边一座不点灯的寨子，寨里的人走路不出声，说话打手势，船桨裹着布，是专在雾里摸黑跑船的暗航帮。雾海水师的人马在寨外扎了两层营，要把他们一网打尽，可暗航帮在雾里来去无影，水兵、弩手、跳帮手围了半个月，连个人影都没摸着。

A stockade on the shore that never lights a lamp. Its people walk without a sound, talk with their hands, and wrap their oars in cloth: a dark-sailing gang that runs boats through the fog unseen. The Fog Sea navy has camped two rings around it to take them all, but in fog the gang comes and goes like smoke, and in half a month of siege the marines, crossbowmen and boarders haven't laid a hand on one of them.
after: 水师的营被打散，暗航帮的头领这才现身，比划着手势说：夜航是跟鲍家学的。他们顺着暖水往东南摸过一回，摸到一处地方，雾自己发着亮，海面平得像镜子，远处隐隐有楼台。「我们不敢再往前，就回来了。老针敢。」

The navy's camps are broken, and only then does the gang's leader show himself, saying in signs that they learned night sailing from the Bao family. Once they felt their way south-east along the warm water and came to a place where the fog glowed of itself, the sea lay flat as a mirror, and towers showed faintly in the distance. 'We didn't dare go further. We turned back. Old Needle dared.'

name: 唱坛坊
The Singing Crocks
before: 一座腌菜坊，院里排着几百口大坛，坊主是个胖大嫂，腌菜时一边压菜一边唱歌，说菜听了歌才入味。一伙雾海弩手逼她给舰队腌菜，嫌她唱歌耽误工夫，要她闭嘴干活。她不唱，菜就压不实；压不实，弩手就骂。院子里一片咸味和骂声。

A pickling works with hundreds of great crocks in the yard, run by a big, cheerful woman who sings as she packs the greens, saying they only take the brine if they've heard a song. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has her pickling for the fleet and tells her to stop singing and work. When she doesn't sing, the greens won't pack tight, and when they won't pack tight, the crossbowmen shout. The yard is all salt smell and swearing.
after: 弩手被赶走，大嫂又唱上了。寄存栈那三百坛就是她腌的：沈船主来订菜，她唱了一首，沈船主跟着哼。「她说回程的菜要腌得久一点，久了才香。」大嫂掰着手指算：「腌了十年，该香透了。」

With the crossbowmen gone, the woman sings again. The three hundred crocks in the deposit store are hers. When Owner Shen came to order them, she sang, and Shen hummed along. 'She said pickles for the way home should cure a long time, the longer the better.' The woman counts on her fingers. 'Ten years. They ought to be just right.'

name: 隔栏饭
Dinner Over the Rail
before: 一道木栅栏把路拦腰截断，栏里是一队雾海水兵，栏外是一群提着饭篮的老太太。水兵都是集上人家的儿子，被拉进水师的，不许出营；娘们不许进营，只好隔着栏杆递饭。今天水兵接了令，不许再递，要把路彻底封死，娘们把饭篮举过头顶，谁也不肯退。

A wooden fence cuts the road in two. Inside is a squad of Fog Sea marines; outside, a crowd of old women with food baskets. The marines are sons of market families pressed into the navy and forbidden to leave camp; the mothers are forbidden to enter, so they pass meals over the rail. Today the marines have orders to stop that and seal the road for good, and the mothers hold their baskets over their heads and won't give an inch.
after: 水兵败了，娘们一拥而上，抱着儿子又打又哭。一个年轻水兵捧着饭碗说：老针走后，舰上没人认得暖水那一线，船在雾里一年撞一条。提督前几天下了令：「访鲍家后人，请上旗舰领港。」说的是「请」。

The marines are beaten and the mothers rush in, hugging their sons and slapping them and weeping. A young marine holding his rice bowl tells you that since Old Needle left, no one in the fleet can find the warm strip, and they lose a ship on the rocks every year. A few days ago the admiral issued an order: 'Seek out the Bao family's heir and invite him to pilot the flagship.' It says 'invite'.

name: 请人艇
The Invitation Boat
before: 海边停着一条挂红绸的快艇，艇上摆着一张空椅子，椅背上贴着「领港」两个字。一队雾海水兵在滩上排成两行，见了小桨就上来作揖：「小鲍爷，提督请您上船。」作完揖，见他不肯，就伸手来拽。小桨抱住后千里的缆桩不撒手。

A fast boat hung with red silk waits on the shore, an empty chair set in it with the word 'Pilot' pasted on its back. A squad of Fog Sea marines forms two lines on the beach and bows to Xiaojiang: 'Young Master Bao, the admiral invites you aboard.' The bowing done, and finding him unwilling, they reach out to drag him. Xiaojiang wraps his arms round Houqianli's bollard and won't let go.
after: 水兵们被赶回了艇上，椅子也搬走了。小桨喘着气说：「爷爷领千里号，不领截千里号的。」领头的水兵倒也没生气，回头说了句：「提督也是这么猜的。他说，鲍家的人，十年前就该请，不该抓。」

The marines are driven back into their boat, chair and all. 'Grandpa piloted the Qianli,' Xiaojiang pants. 'He doesn't pilot the ones who stop it.' The marines' leader isn't even angry. Over his shoulder he says, 'The admiral guessed you'd say that. He said ten years ago he should have invited the Bao family, not arrested them.'

name: 敲罟湾
Drum-Fishing Bay
before: 海湾里几十条小船围成一个大圈，渔民拿木槌敲着船帮，梆梆梆响成一片，把黄鱼往网里赶。一伙雾海跳帮手驾着快艇冲进圈里，抢了鱼就跑，把网也划破了。领头的渔老大气得直跺船板：「黄鱼一年只来这几天！」

Dozens of small boats ring the bay in a great circle, the fishermen hammering their gunwales with mallets, a rattle of wood driving the yellow croakers into the nets. A gang of Fog Sea boarders races into the ring in fast boats, grabs fish, slashes the nets and makes off. The head fisherman stamps on his deck in fury: 'The croakers only come these few days a year!'
after: 跳帮手被打散，网补上了，鱼也赶进去了。渔老大说，夏天黄鱼顺着暖水来，夜里会叫，咕咕咕地，贴着船板就听得见。鲍老针那年就是贴着船板听鱼叫领的路：「鱼往哪儿叫，暖水就在哪儿。」

The boarders are scattered, the nets mended and the fish driven in. In summer, the head fisherman says, the croakers come along the warm water, and at night they call, a croak-croak-croak you can hear with your ear to the planking. That year Bao Laozhen led the way with his ear on the boards. 'Wherever the fish are calling, that's where the warm water is.'

name: 沉舰滩
Wrecked Warship Beach
before: 一片长滩上躺着十几条破战船，有的断了桅，有的只剩龙骨，船头都还插着雾海水师的旗。这是水师自己的沉船，十年里在雾里撞礁撞沉的，拖上岸拆了补别的船。一大队水兵、弩手、跳帮手在滩上拆船，见了你们，放下锤子就抄起了刀。

A dozen broken warships lie along a long beach, some dismasted, some nothing but keels, every bow still flying the Fog Sea navy's flag. These are the navy's own wrecks, ten years of ships run onto rocks in the fog and dragged ashore to be stripped for repairs. A large force of marines, crossbowmen and boarders is breaking them up, and at the sight of you they drop their hammers and take up blades.
after: 拆船的兵散了。每条破船的船尾都钉着一块木牌，写着船名和沉的那一年，还有一行人名。牌子是提督亲手写的，十年，一块不落。领头的老兵说：「令一天不撤，船就一条条地沉。提督知道，他就是不撤。」

The wrecking crews scatter. On the stern of each wreck is nailed a board with the ship's name, the year it sank, and a line of names. The admiral wrote every board himself, ten years, not one missed. 'Every day the order stands, another ship goes down,' says the old soldier in charge. 'The admiral knows it. He still won't lift it.'

name: 回声谷
Echo Hollow
before: 荒原上一道浅谷，谷两边是陡土坎，人在谷里喊一声，回声能折三四回。盲舟塾的老领港们常来这里练耳朵。如今一队雾海水兵把谷占了做营盘，说回声乱，敌人摸不进来。小桨站在谷口，非要进去喊一嗓子。

A shallow hollow on the moor between steep earth banks, where one shout comes back three or four times over. The old pilots of the blind school used to come here to train their ears. Now a squad of Fog Sea marines has taken it for a camp, reckoning the echoes will confuse any attacker. Xiaojiang stands at the mouth of the hollow, determined to go in and shout.
after: 水兵被赶出了谷。小桨站在谷底喊了一声，闭着眼数：一声快，两声慢，一声远。他睁开眼，笑得像捡了宝：「左边近，右边远，后头还有一道坎！」盲老塾师在谷口点头：「鲍家的耳朵，回来了。」

The marines are driven out. Xiaojiang stands in the bottom of the hollow, shouts once, and counts with his eyes shut: one fast, two slow, one far. He opens his eyes grinning as if he'd found treasure. 'Close on the left, far on the right, and another bank behind!' At the mouth of the hollow the blind old master nods. 'The Bao ears are back.'

name: 花舢板
The Flower Skiff
before: 海边一户渔家门口摆着一条旧舢板，舱里填满了土，种着一船凤仙花，红红紫紫。一伙雾海跳帮手冲过来，要把舢板拖走：提督新下的令，凡是鲍老针的东西，一件不许落在外头。渔婆子护着花骂：「这是我十年前领回来的，花都开了十茬了！」

Outside a fisher family's door sits an old skiff, its hull filled with earth and planted with a boatload of balsam flowers, red and purple. A gang of Fog Sea boarders rushes up to haul it away: the admiral's new order says nothing of Bao Laozhen's may be left in other hands. The fisherwife shields her flowers and scolds: 'I claimed this ten years ago! These flowers have bloomed ten times!'
after: 跳帮手跑了。小桨扒开花根，在船板缝里摸出一只竹筒，是爷爷的字：「工钱收齐，银子随船送回。我跟船走，不回了。雾尽头有座楼，有人在楼里等船，船上缺领港。告诉老婆子，别等。」小桨揣起竹筒，一句话没说。

The boarders are chased off. Xiaojiang parts the roots and, wedged between two planks, finds a bamboo tube that was never opened. Inside, in his grandfather's hand: 'Fee received in full; silver sent back in the boat. I'm going on with the ship and won't return. At the end of the fog there's a tower, and someone in it waiting for ships, and the ship needs a pilot. Tell the old woman not to wait.' Xiaojiang tucks the tube inside his coat and says nothing at all.

name: 暖水口炮台
Warm Gate Battery
before: 海岸尽头一座炮台，炮口一律对着东南：那一线暖水就是从这里出雾海的。炮台上驻着雾海水师的一大队人马，水兵守炮，弩手站墙，跳帮手守着滩上的快艇。十年来炮台天天擦炮，一炮没放，今天看见后千里的灯，炮手们手忙脚乱地装药。

A battery at the far end of the coast, every gun aimed south-east, for it is here that the warm strip leaves the Sea of Fog. A large company of the Fog Sea navy holds it: marines on the guns, crossbowmen on the wall, boarders with the fast boats on the beach. For ten years they've polished the guns every day and never fired one. Today they see Houqianli's lanterns and the gunners scramble to load.
after: 炮台被打下，炮手们反倒松了口气。值夜簿十年前八月廿八写着：「千里号五船过暖水口，炮十发，皆不中。六号横撞，截获。五船东南去，雾中忽见楼台，入，不见。提督令：止，不追。」那一夜之后，炮就再没响过。

The battery falls and the gunners actually sigh with relief. The night log, twenty-eighth of the eighth month ten years ago: 'Five Qianli ships passed the Warm Gate. Ten shots, all missed. Number Six rammed broadside, captured. Five ships went south-east. Towers suddenly seen in the fog. They entered and vanished. Admiral's order: halt, no pursuit.' After that night the guns never spoke again.

name: 鬼船坳
Ghost Ship Hollow
before: 荒原上一处低洼，每逢大雾，雾就积在坳里，像一锅白粥。坳底竖着一条破船，船身涂着白灰，桅上挂着烂帆，雾一浓，船上就亮起绿莹莹的光，有人拖着铁链在甲板上走。过路的人吓得扔下货就跑。坳边的雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手都是逃兵和贼，正等着捡货。

A low hollow on the moor where, in thick fog, the fog pools like a pot of white porridge. A wrecked ship stands upright in the bottom, its hull daubed white, rotten sails on its mast, and when the fog thickens a green glow lights up aboard and someone drags a chain across the deck. Travellers drop their goods and run. The marines, crossbowmen and boarders round the hollow are deserters and thieves, waiting to pick up what's dropped.
after: 这一伙装鬼的被赶了出来，绿光原来是腐木上的荧光菌，铁链是从扣船坞偷的。可这条破船搁在这里一天，大雾一来，就总有新的一伙人爬上去，涂白脸，拖铁链，装神弄鬼。过一阵，你们还得再来赶一回。

This lot of fake ghosts is driven out; the green glow turns out to be fungus shining on rotten wood, and the chain was stolen from the impound yard. But as long as the wreck stands here, every thick fog brings a new gang up its sides to whiten their faces, rattle chains and play the ghost. Before long you'll have to come and clear it again.

name: 送灯滩
Lantern-Send Beach
before: 海边一片沙滩，从前每年中元，渔家都在这里放水灯，一盏灯一个名字，顺着暖水漂走。灭灯以后，滩上不许放灯，一伙雾海跳帮手占了滩头的渔寮，把渔家的船、网、米缸都封了，说放过灯的人家都要罚。渔家们蹲在滩上，手里攥着折好的纸灯，不敢点。

A sandy beach where every Ghost Festival the fisher families used to float water lanterns, one lantern for each name, drifting away on the warm water. Since the lights went out, no lanterns are allowed here. A gang of Fog Sea boarders has taken the fishing huts at the head of the beach and sealed the families' boats, nets and rice jars, fining every household that ever floated a lantern. The families crouch on the sand clutching folded paper lanterns they don't dare light.
after: 跳帮手被赶走，渔寮解了封。当夜渔家们把憋了十年的水灯一齐点着，放进暖水里，一串灯往东南漂，漂进雾里还看得见。小桨也放了一盏，没写名字。

The boarders are driven off and the huts unsealed. That night the families light ten years of held-back lanterns all at once and set them on the warm water, and a string of lights drifts south-east, still visible as it enters the fog. Xiaojiang floats one too. He doesn't write a name on it.
first: 渔寮里抄出跳帮手囤的五十斤鱼干、两缸米、一捆新网，还有一箱收缴来的纸灯，折得整整齐齐，一盏都没舍得烧。

In the huts you find the boarders' hoard: fifty jin of dried fish, two jars of rice, a bundle of new nets, and a chest of confiscated paper lanterns, neatly folded, not one of which they had the heart to burn.
pass: 每次路过，渔家都给你们一篓刚出水的鱼，再塞一盏折好的纸灯：「路上用不着就放了它，替我们问个好。」
Every time you pass, the fisher families give you a basket of fish fresh from the water and a folded paper lantern. 'If you don't need it on the road, float it, and say hello for us.'

name: 补帆寮
The Sail Loft
before: 海角尽头一座补帆的大寮，寮里挂着一面面破帆，像一群晾着的大鸟。老帆匠满手老茧，一根大针使得飞快。他有个怪规矩：要他补帆、跟他换货，先打赢他寮里的徒弟。徒弟们都是退下来的雾海水兵，个个膀大腰圆，十年里只有一个人打赢过。

At the tip of the headland stands a great sail loft, torn sails hanging inside like huge birds set out to dry. The old sailmaker has hands of callus and a big needle that flies. He has an odd rule: if you want a sail mended or a trade made, first beat his apprentices. They are all retired Fog Sea marines, every one built like a door, and in ten years only one person has ever beaten them.
after: 徒弟们服了，老帆匠痛快地跟你们换货。十年里打赢过的那一个，是沈船主。镇雾号的帆也是他补的，提督每年来取，都要他把帆缝结实点：「哪天令撤了，要追很远。」老帆匠说：「令撤不撤，你们去问问他本人吧。」

The apprentices concede and the old sailmaker trades with you gladly. The one who beat them, ten years ago, was Owner Shen. He mends the Zhenwu's sails too, and every year when the admiral comes for them, he asks that they be sewn extra strong: 'The day the order's lifted, I'll have a long way to chase.' 'Whether it's lifted or not,' says the old sailmaker, 'go and ask the man himself.'

name: 落篷滩
Sail-Drop Reeds
before: 沼泽边一片芦苇滩，滩头有几道宽宽的旧泥槽，像是很多年前有大船拖过来。一队雾海水兵在这里割芦苇，割得一根不剩，说是提督有令：「沿岸不许留藏船之处。」割苇的老汉跟在后头捡苇子，嘴里嘀咕：「藏船？十年前人家是大大方方靠上来的。」

A reed bed at the marsh's edge with a few broad old grooves in the mud, as if big boats were hauled up here years ago. A squad of Fog Sea marines is cutting every reed to the ground: the admiral's orders, no hiding places for boats along the shore. The old reed-cutter follows behind gathering up the stalks and muttering, 'Hiding? Ten years ago they came in bold as you like.'
after: 水兵被赶走，老汉扛着苇子说：十年前八月，雾里出来六条小艇，说是千里号的，三百人轮着上岸，在这一带住了三天，买东西个个付现钱，走的时候把借来的锅碗都刷得锃亮还回来。「三百个人，三天，没一个赖账的。」

The marines are driven off. Shouldering his reeds, the old man says that in the eighth month ten years ago six boats came out of the fog, from the Qianli, they said, and three hundred people came ashore by turns. They stayed three days, paid cash for everything, and when they left they returned every borrowed pot and bowl scrubbed bright. 'Three hundred people, three days, and not one left a debt.'

name: 老酱园
The Old Soy Yard
before: 村头一座酱园，几百口酱缸晒在太阳底下，雾里也闻得到豆酱的香。一伙雾海跳帮手占了酱园，掀开缸盖拿手指头蘸着吃，蘸完一缸换一缸。老酱工急得直跺脚：「缸盖不能乱掀！进了生水，一缸酱就毁了！」

A soy yard at the head of the village, hundreds of crocks of bean paste set out to sun, and even in fog you can smell it. A gang of Fog Sea boarders has taken the yard and goes from crock to crock, lifting lids and dipping their fingers. The old paste-maker is frantic: 'Don't lift those lids! One drop of raw water and the whole crock's ruined!'
after: 跳帮手被赶走，缸盖一个个盖了回去。老酱工说千里号的大厨老鼎当年来过，挨缸尝了一遍，买走最老的三缸，没讲价，留下一个方子：豆子多晒三天。村里照着做，管它叫「千里酱」。「千里号走了，酱留下了。」

The boarders are driven off and the lids go back on one by one. The Qianli's head cook, Old Ding, came here back then, says the paste-maker. He tasted every crock, bought the three oldest without haggling, and left a tip: sun the beans three days longer. The village has done it ever since and calls it Qianli paste. 'The Qianli left. The paste stayed.'

name: 百岁堂
The Centenarian's Hall
before: 村中一座老祠堂，堂上坐着村里最老的人，一百零二岁，耳朵不好，记性比谁都好。一伙雾海弩手把祠堂占了做哨所，要老人挪地方。老人坐在太师椅上一动不动，弩手连人带椅子往外抬，抬到门槛，椅子卡住了，进不得，出不得。

An old ancestral hall in the middle of the village, where the oldest person in the village sits, a hundred and two, hard of hearing and with the best memory of anyone. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has taken the hall for a guardhouse and wants the old man moved. He sits in his armchair and won't budge, so they carry him out chair and all, and at the threshold the chair sticks, and now it will go neither in nor out.
after: 弩手被赶走，椅子抬回了原处。老人说十年前有个女船主来拜过他，腰上挂一柄短刀，问他雾有没有尽头。他说老辈传下来，雾尽头有一座楼，楼里的人不会老。她笑了：「那正好，我们要走很久。」

The crossbowmen are driven off and the chair carried back to its place. Ten years ago, the old man says, a woman shipowner came to pay her respects, a short sword at her belt, and asked whether the fog had an end. He told her what the old folk passed down: at the end of the fog there's a tower, and the people in it never grow old. She laughed. 'Good. We have a long way to go.'

name: 残局廊
The Unfinished Game
before: 渔村的一条廊檐下摆着一张石桌，桌上一盘象棋，下到一半，棋子上落满了灰，十年没人动过。一队雾海水兵嫌石桌碍路，要把棋盘掀了，把桌子砸了垫路。守棋的老渔翁张开两只手护着棋盘：「掀不得！这盘棋还没下完！」

Under the eaves of a fishing village stands a stone table with a game of xiangqi on it, half played, the pieces thick with ten years of dust, never touched. A squad of Fog Sea marines finds the table in their way and means to sweep the board off and smash the table for paving. The old fisherman who keeps it spreads his arms over the board: 'You can't! The game isn't finished!'
after: 水兵被赶走。老渔翁说，对面那一方是千里号的领港，姓许，下到一半船要开了，他说：「留着，回来下完。」阿汐盯着棋盘看了很久，认出这是她爹的路数，先弃车，后将军。她伸出手，又缩了回来：「等他自己来走。」

The marines are driven off. His opponent, the old fisherman says, was the Qianli's pilot, a man named Xu. Halfway through the game the ship was ready to sail, and he said, 'Leave it. I'll finish it when I'm back.' Axi stares at the board a long time and recognises her father's style: sacrifice the chariot first, then check. She reaches out a hand and draws it back. 'He can make his own move.'

name: 番薯烧坊
The Potato Still
before: 荒原上一座烧酒坊，拿番薯酿酒，酒烈得能点着。一伙雾海弩手占了酒坊，喝得东倒西歪，酒糟扔了一地，鸡啄了酒糟也醉，满院子鸡走着醉步。坊主的老婆拎着扫帚追着弩手打，弩手醉得连弩都端不稳，射了一上午，射中了三只酒坛。

A distillery on the moor that makes spirit from sweet potatoes, strong enough to burn. A gang of Fog Sea crossbowmen has taken it over and drunk itself silly; spent mash covers the yard, the chickens have eaten it and are drunk too, and staggering birds weave across the yard. The owner's wife chases the crossbowmen with a broom, and they're too drunk to hold their crossbows steady: a morning's shooting has hit three wine jars.
after: 弩手被扫地出门，酒坊又冒起了蒸汽。墙上挂着一块木板，刻满了三百道道：千里号的水手在这儿喝过三天，临走说：「每人欠一碗，回来请全村喝。」坊主每年封一坛老酒，「等他们回来，一碗都不能少」。

The crossbowmen are swept out the door and the still steams again. On the wall hangs a board scored with three hundred marks. The Qianli's sailors drank here three days, and when they left they said, 'Each of us owes a bowl. When we're back, the whole village drinks on us.' The owner seals one jar of old spirit every year. 'When they come back, not one bowl short.'
first: 坊里抄出弩手囤的二十坛烧酒、一缸酒糟鱼、两袋番薯干，还有一只醉得站不起来的老母鸡，坊主说是弩手偷来的，就送你们炖汤。

In the still you find the crossbowmen's hoard: twenty jars of spirit, a crock of mash-cured fish, two sacks of dried sweet potato, and an old hen too drunk to stand, stolen by the crossbowmen; the owner says take it for soup.
pass: 每次路过，坊主都灌一壶热酒给你们暖身子，又塞一包烤番薯干：「雾里冷，喝一口，不许多喝。」
Every time you pass, the owner fills a flask of warm spirit for you and slips you a packet of roasted sweet-potato strips. 'Cold in the fog. One mouthful. No more.'

name: 拔河坪
Tug-of-War Green
before: 村口一片大草坪，坪边的社庙梁上挂着一根粗麻绳，比碗口还粗，绳上打着六十个结，每个结上拴着一块小木牌。一大队雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手驻在坪上，要把这根绳子拿去当锚缆：舰队的缆绳烂得差不多了。村里的壮汉们抓着绳子另一头，不撒手。

A wide green at the village gate, and hanging from the beam of the shrine beside it a hemp rope thicker than a bowl's mouth, tied with sixty knots, a little wooden tag on each. A large force of Fog Sea marines, crossbowmen and boarders has camped on the green to take the rope for an anchor cable, since the fleet's are nearly rotted through. The village's strong men have hold of the other end and won't let go.
after: 水师被赶走，绳子挂回了梁上。十年前千里号的六十个水手跟村里六十条汉子拔过一场河，眼看要赢，大厨老鼎一敲锅喊「开饭」，六十人一齐撒了手。每个结上的木牌都刻着一个水手的名字，「说好回来再拔一场」。

The navy is driven off and the rope goes back on its beam. Ten years ago, sixty of the Qianli's sailors had a tug-of-war against sixty of their men. The sailors were just about to win when Old Ding the cook banged a pot at the edge of the green and shouted 'Dinner!', and all sixty let go at once. Each tag carries one sailor's name. 'They said they'd come back for a rematch.'

name: 女医龛
The Doctor's Shrine
before: 村后山坡上一座小小的石龛，龛里供的不是神，是一只药箱，箱前摆着鸡蛋、红枣、小孩的虎头鞋。一队雾海水兵上来要砸龛，说村里人「供奉千里号，有违军令」。一群妇人把龛围得严严实实，有人怀里还抱着孩子。

A tiny stone shrine on the hillside behind the village, and in it no god but a medicine chest, with eggs, red dates and a child's tiger-head shoes laid before it. A squad of Fog Sea marines has come to smash it, saying the villagers 'worship the Qianli, contrary to military orders'. A crowd of women surrounds the shrine shoulder to shoulder, some with babies in their arms.
after: 水兵被赶走，妇人们给龛前换了新鸡蛋。十年前村里闹痘，千里号上的柳医娘子上岸三天没合眼，一个孩子也没让死。走时她把药箱留下：「一年后回来补药。」那年救下的孩子，如今都十来岁了，每人往龛前放过一双鞋。

The marines are driven off and the women set out fresh eggs. Ten years ago smallpox broke out in the village, and the Qianli's doctor, Madam Liu, came ashore and went three days without sleep and didn't let one child die. When she left she said of the chest: 'I'll be back in a year to restock it.' The children saved that year are around ten now, and each has left a pair of shoes at the shrine.

name: 六桩滩
Six-Stone Beach
before: 海边一溜六块大石头，每块上都有一道深深的缆槽，刻着「一」到「六」：十年前千里号的六条小艇就系在这里。一伙雾海跳帮手正拿铁锤凿石头上的字，凿一个，换一块，叮叮当当，火星乱溅。凿到第六块，锤子崩了个口。

Six great stones in a row along the shore, each with a deep groove worn by a mooring line and carved with a number, one to six: ten years ago the Qianli's six boats were tied up here. A gang of Fog Sea boarders is hammering the numbers off, one stone after another, chips and sparks flying. At the sixth stone the hammer breaks its edge.
after: 跳帮手被赶走。第六块石头上除了「六」，还刻着一行小字，凿不动，石头太硬：「六号断后。沈。」原来那一夜六号横撞舰队，是船主早就定下的。阿汐摸着那几个字说：「她什么都算好了，就是没算自己的船回不回得来。」

The boarders are driven off. Besides the 'six', the sixth stone bears a line of small characters the hammer couldn't touch, the stone is too hard: 'Number Six covers the rear. Shen.' So Number Six's ramming of the fleet that night was the owner's plan from the start. Axi runs her fingers over the words. 'She planned everything except whether her own ships would make it back.'
